cases.why: Real message. No مبلغ label, the amount is a bare -5,025,000 on its own line, and a reference number sits between it and the مانده. Reading the minus sign as an identifier dash skipped the amount and took «020» out of the reference instead — harmless here because the مانده wins, and a silent nonsense in any message without one.

body: بانک خاورمیانه برداشت وجه از خودپرداز
cases.why: A number she confirmed herself must read exactly like a built-in one. A shortcode is exactly itself: no country code bolted on, nothing trimmed off.

body: انتقال از اینترنت بانک از کارت 9295
cases.why: Real message from issue #46; the stars are the reporter's redaction. Money arriving from another card, yet «انتقال» read it as a spend and the card's last four digits as the amount: the ledger showed a 929 Toman withdrawal. The signed line is the amount and its sign is the direction, whatever the words say.
